summary: DoubleLine Yield Opportunities Fund filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement on October 2, 2026 for an at-the-market offering of up to $241 million of common shares under a distribution agreement with Foreside Fund Services as distributor and UBS Securities as sub-placement agent. No price per share, premium, or stake is stated; sales may occur at prevailing market prices. The closed-end fund pays a 1.35% monthly management fee on managed assets and uses leverage equal to 16.11% of total managed assets. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch for NAV discount accretion and leverage-driven distribution sustainability.
